# Chris Misztur

> Chris Misztur is the President & Founder of Mr. IIoT, dedicated to building Smart Factories, both real and virtual. With over two decades of experience, he specializes in digitally transforming manufacturing through innovative IoT solutions and Industry 4.0 expertise, identifying inefficiencies and applying cutting-edge technologies.

Based in the Greater Chicago Area, Chris brings 25+ years of experience in industrial IoT, digital transformation, and smart factory implementation. His expertise includes the "5C" closed-loop feedback approach and solutions like the SHARC IoT Adapter and DIME Software Suite.
